character.description: Sena: composed young woman, blue-black bob, pale high collar jacket with two brass clasps, navy wide trousers, brown shoes and record board at right hip. Preserve full-body proportions and outfit from base. Three-quarter facing screen right; feet fixed.

idle.action: Feet and body position fixed. Subtle breathing cycle: neutral, slight inhale, a single blink, return to neutral. Hands down, no gestures.

victory.action: Quiet restrained victory. Frame 1 neutral looking slightly down at board, frame 2 lift gaze, frame 3 bend right elbow bringing one small closed fist to lower chest, frame 4 hold that small fist with a faint satisfied smile. Left arm remains down. Feet planted throughout. No extra limbs or effects.

style: crisp pixel art, flat limited palette, no antialiasing
